desc: Implement NTT-based polynomial multiplication and division to compute $P(z) = \prod_{d=1}^6 (1 + z \cdot 10^d)^{cnt_d}$ modulo 998244353.
For each digit length $d \in \{1,\ldots,6\}$, compute the polynomial $Q_d(z) = P(z) / (1 + z \cdot 10^d)$ modulo 998244353.
For each $d$, compute $S_d = \sum_{j=0}^{N-1} [z^j]Q_d(z)$, the sum of coefficients of $Q_d(z)$ up to degree $N-1$.
Compute the sum of all numbers $x \in \{1,\ldots,N\}$ with $d$ digits for each $d$, denoted $Sum_d$.
Compute the final answer as $(N-1)! \cdot \sum_{d=1}^6 S_d \cdot Sum_d \pmod{998244353}$.
Implement the solution using the simplified formula:
Group sums and counts by length.
